skillFull: Brings letters at given intervals. Love Letters activate Blast Mode with Magnetism, Friendship Letters activate Giant Mode. Both sorts of letters slow down the Energy Drain for a short while. Level Up for a slower Energy Drain when receiving the letters.
story: A happy post office bird set out to deliver love to the Cookie World. This veteran misdelivered only one letter in its lifetime. Can you guess whose letter was it?

costumes.name: Chuseok Courtesies
costumes.info: This trusty companion soars across every corner of the land! Cotton Candy Cookie can't be everywhere herself, so this lovely Pet delivers heartfelt letters on her behalf. Its wings must ache from flying more than usual, but the moment someone receives a letter, seeing the joy on their faces makes Cotton Candy Bird's wings feel light as air once more!
